Definition: Whether the ID authority and system are subject to general oversight of the courts and judicial review
Value Name: Yes, but not specific to ID
Comments: Tanzania has general judicial oversight but no ID-specific mechanisms. Under RIPA, appeals for refusal or cancellation of ID go only to the Director of Registration and then the Minister (final decision) — courts cannot review ID refusals. The RIA 2021 report notes no independent judicial redress. General court system applies but no dedicated ID court oversight.
